scripts.storage:up: node scripts/ensure-graphene-dev-network.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yaml up -d --wait rustfs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yaml up rustfs-init
scripts.storage:down: node scripts/ensure-graphene-dev-network.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yaml rm -sf rustfs rustfs-init
scripts.worker:up: node scripts/ensure-graphene-dev-network.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yaml up -d --build render
scripts.worker:down: node scripts/ensure-graphene-dev-network.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yaml rm -sf render
scripts.worker:restart: node scripts/ensure-graphene-dev-network.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yaml restart render
scripts.worker:logs: node scripts/ensure-graphene-dev-network.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yaml logs -f render
